Live probe results: ollama = config surface REMOTE-UNVERIFIED because the estate loader resolves .env OLLAMA_HOST=http://ollama:11434 (docker hostname, non-local, so config-only per law); direct route-correct probe of the yaml default 127.0.0.1:11434 gives GET /api/tags HTTP 200 with 16 models = ALIVE, and GET /v1 HTTP 404 reproduced (POST-only route family, the operator's false alarm confirmed). saelis = DORMANT (marker respected, port never probed by the check); direct TCP 127.0.0.1:8080 = WinError 10061 refused, confirming the operator's browser byte. mlx-cluster stub = DOWN (TimeoutError; this box firewall-drops SYNs, detail wording fixed to not call a timeout a refusal).
